set.body:
Outcome: after the scene preview, a detail-level recall-to-film mapping in the same bundle: recall detail atoms, a source cast and row record, detail binding with graded fidelity, derived coverage and omission, an order-independent condition, and who-did-what. Each field set is qualified on fresh items against one joint blind human coding effort.
Plan: docs/plans/2026-11-16-detail-mapping-plan.md (DL1-DL6). Supersedes roadmap M3 (speaker-labelled evidence) and M4 (who-did-what). E1 beyond the cast record, E3 and E4 become retained research.
Acceptance: DL1-DL4 exits met on fresh items and DL5 has a recorded claim-boundary decision. Claim children, not this container.
Owner request in chat 2026-11-16.
set.title: [detail-mapping] Detail-level recall-to-film mapping after the scene preview
